items.response:
Glad you landed safely. I do not have the flight search or the Lafourcade song idea in front of me, so I will find both rather than guess at prices or songs.
Action: Find the flight search from before you booked and compare its price with what you paid, and find the Lafourcade song idea so you can send it to Mei.

Happy to. I do not know what you want or which shop, so tell me the shop and the order and I will place it for pickup in 15 minutes.
Action: Wait for the shop and items, then place the pickup order and confirm the time.

Saved to a private health note.
- Penicillin allergy: hives
- Seasonal allergies in May: managed with Reactine
Action: Save both to a private health note and keep them out of shared notes.

Added Grace's 68th birthday on Thu 19 Nov 2026 to the calendar. I will remind you on Thu 5 Nov, two weeks ahead, to sort a gift. Since you are in Ottawa Fri 13 to Sun 15 Nov, a gift in hand before you leave could be given in person.
Action: Add the birthday as an all-day event on 2026-11-19 and set a reminder on 2026-11-05.

Done on the pickup: the food is available at Queen & Logan today. Here is a short Slack draft: 'Quick reminder: release freeze runs Thu 12:00 to Mon 09:00 for the bank-partner cutover. Please get anything you need merged by Thursday morning, and ping Aisha if something urgent comes up. Thanks all.' Aisha already has a similar message scheduled for Thu 07:00, so this one may overlap.
Action: Set up the in-store pickup for Biscuit's food for Sam, and save the Slack draft without posting it.

Will do. I will tell Hannah yes: she grabs both boys at 3:30, pizza and a movie, and brings Leo back tomorrow morning in time to walk in together with Jun. I will put the sleepover on the family calendar from 3:30 today to tomorrow morning.
Action: Text Hannah a yes, add the sleepover to the family calendar, and remind you to pack Leo's overnight things.

Good things to ask on the tours: the teacher-to-child ratio and group size, how long the staff have been there, what a normal day looks like including naps, and the illness and sick-day policy. Also ask about food and allergies, how they communicate with parents, safety and pickup procedures, and whether the fees are all-in and the centre is in the $10-a-day program. A trial day or a second visit at a busy time is worth asking for too.
Action: Turn this into a short list you can send to Marcus.

I do not have live prices, but I can get you a rough range for the August long weekend, which should be Aug 1-3 in 2026 (I will confirm the exact days). I will price it for just you and for you plus Leo, with Air Canada, aisle seats, no basic economy, and prices in CAD.
Action: Search Air Canada Toronto to Vancouver for the August long weekend for one and two travellers and send you a rough range.

So far this morning:
- Added the dog walker Felipe (Paws on Pape) to the pet budget: $50/week, about $217/month, bringing total dog walking to $125/week, about $542/month, and monthly pet spend to about $729 against the $350 budget.
- Pulled the six open payouts launch risks from Linear into the Notion page 'Payouts v2 launch risks (2025-11-12)' for standup.
- Still running: October grocery total, compared with August and September.
Action: Report the grocery numbers when they come back.

I can work it out, but I need a couple of things: what time school pickup ends and where Sam's parents' place is. I will use the address in your contacts if you do not give me one, and allow for Friday afternoon traffic.
Action: Look up Sam's parents' address, estimate the drive with Friday traffic from school pickup, and give you an arrival time range.

Yes, COUNTIF is enough: =COUNTIF(D:D,">10000") counts payouts strictly over $10,000. Use ">=10000" if exactly $10,000 should count too.
Action: None.

Yes, it used to be in January. The season grew over the years, with more regular-season games and a longer playoff, which pushed the final into February, and Sunday is the tradition because it is the biggest night for TV audiences.
Action: None.

The 504 at rush hour is rough, a backpack in the face for the whole ride is a bad start. Still open on my side: the Sat 10:30 tune-up for Leo's bike at Gears on Gerrard, and where your team wants the beta feedback log to live.
Action: Wait for your go-ahead to book the 10:30 slot at Gears, and for where the feedback log should go.

Sorry about Leo's tooth, a chipped front tooth is worth getting seen quickly. I will look for after-school slots with Dr. Lin this week and work out the travel time from home once I have the office address.
Action: Check Dr. Lin's availability this week after school, look up the address and travel time from home, and show you the best options before booking.

I will put Nate's revised quote next to your numbers. Assuming the $48,000 includes a 10% contingency on top of the base, the contingency is about $4,364 and the base is about $43,636, and I will check how much of that the new quote uses. I need the quote's line items to say for sure.
Action: Find Nate's revised quote, build a side-by-side with your budget, and show how much of the contingency is used.

Welcome home, and driving wrecks you even when it goes fine. Tuesdays that feel like Fridays are the worst.
Action: None, unless you want a lighter plan for today.

Reminder set. Since Tom owns the recurring 1:1, I cannot change his series, but I can fix your copy. I will check for an updated invite from Tom first, and if there is none, I will add a personal Wednesday 11:30 recurring hold starting January 2026 and clear the Thursday one on your calendar.
Action: Check for Tom's updated invite, otherwise fix your copy to Wednesdays at 11:30 and remove the Thursday slot, and add the reminder.

I will text Hannah a yes for Saturday 1 to 4 (a text, not a call, since she is on shift). For a rainy afternoon with Jun and Leo, some options: a Lego challenge where each builds a creature and names the other's, a cushion obstacle course with a timer, a scavenger hunt around the house, and a movie to finish. I can put a plan with times together so you are not refereeing.
Action: Text Hannah yes, add it to the calendar, and send you a short indoor plan for the boys.

Here is what I have: on Sat 17 Jan you asked for photos of zellige tile backsplashes and did not pick one, and then you wanted a few more in white or sage green. I will pull those up along with anything else saved so you can choose by Monday.
Action: Pull the zellige photos and any saved inspiration, narrow them to a shortlist, and text Nate (he prefers texts) once you pick.

Here are two clean ones. 'I would tell you a joke about compound interest, but you would have to wait for the punchline to grow.' Or, for this team: 'I would tell you a payouts joke, but it is still pending.'
Action: None, say the word if you want a different style.

I will build the order for Saturday morning pickup at the PC Express Loblaws Lakeshore 9:00-10:00 slot, with no-name for staples. I will pick unscented dish soap since Sam gets migraines from strong fragrances.
Action: Build the PC Express cart with all the items, then show you the cart and total before checkout.

Easy fix, and a late mug is on brand. I will look for the most absurd novelty mugs and show only the ones that can reach Vancouver within about three days.
Action: Search novelty mugs ranked by ridiculousness and reviews, filter for fast delivery to Vancouver, and show you the top options.

Nut-free camp lunch ideas for Leo, with no tree nuts in anything: 1) turkey and cheese wrap with cucumber and grapes, 2) pasta salad with peas and cheese, 3) sunflower seed butter sandwich with banana, 4) mini pizza bagels with veggie sticks, 5) chicken quesadilla with fruit. Check each label for tree nut warnings and cross-contamination. I do not have the Biscuit and ambulance question in front of me, so I will look it up instead of guessing.
Action: Search our earlier chats for what you asked about Biscuit and the ambulance, and tell you what I find.

I do not know yet. I will check for confirmations of both your and Leo's November appointments.
Action: Search your email and texts for confirmations from the dental office for November, for you and Leo, and report back.

That is a powerful snore for a beagle, and Diego now thinks you are renovating on a Zoom call. Biscuit takes his desk-sleeping duties seriously.
Action: None.

Here is a draft: 'Hannah, thank you so much for the shortbread! Leo ate four, so it was a huge hit. We owe you one.'
Action: Show you the draft and send it to Hannah once you say go.

Happy to look. I need your dates for the 3 nights in the week of Mar 16 and how you are getting there, and then I will find kid-friendly hotels in Drumheller and the Royal Tyrrell Museum price for Leo. I will show everything in CAD and not book anything without your approval.
Action: Search Drumheller hotels for three nights and check Tyrrell's child ticket price, then present options in CAD for your decision.

That sounds like the best part of the week. Enjoy the coffee, and the career day talk prep can wait until you are ready.
Action: None for now, I will hold the talk draft until you ask.

I will make a focus playlist with Khruangbin and A. R. Rahman instrumentals for tomorrow. I will end your spin classes and set up strength training at the Leslieville YMCA on Tuesdays and Thursdays at 6:15 am, with a hard stop to be home by 7:15 so Sam can leave for school.
Action: Remove the recurring spin events, add the Tue/Thu 6:15 strength sessions with a 7:15 home reminder, and build the playlist.

On it. I will find the Purina Pro Plan Sensitive Skin & Stomach salmon formula and check the listing says salmon and not chicken before I add it.
Action: Find the right listing, verify the flavour and size, and place the reorder, then confirm the price and delivery date.

To answer this properly I need the membership fee and what you actually spent at Costco in the past year. I will compare that to the membership cost, and gas and any rewards too if you use them.
Action: Pull the last 12 months of Costco spending from your card statements and the renewal fee, and tell you whether it pays for itself.

I do not know yet. I will check the rink's status and the forecast for Saturday afternoon.
Action: Check the City of Toronto's Withrow rink status and Saturday's forecast, and tell you if it looks good after swim.

Added: Toronto Waterfront Half Marathon, October 19, 2025, 2:04:37, which works out to about 5:54 per km. I will keep it as your official result for the December recap.
Action: Add the race to your running stats and set a December reminder to build the yearly recap.

Pulling them now.
Action: Pull your open Linear tickets tagged payouts-ga and show titles and status only.
